description: secp256k1 ECDSA vectors for ic402 behaviour that Wycheproof does not pin. Built for test/secp256k1.test.mo; how each was made and checked is in the README beside this file.

vectors.name: r + n fallback: x = r is not on the curve, R.x = r + n
vectors.ic402: ecRecover(hash, r, s, 0) recovers pub through its r + n fallback; v = 1 recovers a different key
vectors.ethereum: ecrecover cannot recover it: v is 27 or 28 only, so x = r, which is not on the curve
vectors.noble_curves_2_4_0: verify(prehash: false) accepts; recovery bits 0 and 1 throw (x = r not on the curve); recovery bit 2 recovers pub
